method: Third fresh eighty-round review after Reviews 195-274 and 275-354. Each defect-bearing review was corrected before proceeding. Current repository source truth was rechecked against the current File 25 plan, central governance, current companion contracts and exact-head automated evidence. Staging/live truth remains separate.

reviews.finding: File 25 still recorded File 20 1.2.0 while current exact File 20 main is 1.4.12 with CentralPlanContract 1.0.0.
reviews.correction: Dependency matrix now records exact current version, commit, source range, contract and source-only lifecycle.

reviews.finding: Application-shell availability trusted the version constant alone.
reviews.correction: Added versioned File_20_Integration with min/max, contract and registry checks; dependency availability is revoke-only.

reviews.finding: Current File 20 consumer hook was not supplied, allowing its continuity green fallback instead of File 25 canonical #087A4E.
reviews.correction: File 25 now publishes the reviewed sabri_shell_file25_visual_contract one-way contract.

reviews.finding: File 25 created a duplicate top-level admin area despite File 20 canonical admin architecture.
reviews.correction: Compatible File 20 rehomes Public Experience beneath sabri-shell; standalone mode is degraded fallback only.

reviews.finding: Component Laboratory remained attached to the provisional File 25 top-level menu.
reviews.correction: Component Laboratory is also rehomed beneath the File 20 admin parent.

reviews.finding: sabri_public_register_timeline_provider fired an unconsumed action and was functionally a no-op.
reviews.correction: Added bounded request-local Component_API queue and binding to the single canonical Timeline_Registry.
Added bounded non-overriding variant registry receiving normalized public card DTOs with sanitized output.

reviews.finding: profile type was not allowed and the wrapper's nested profile payload was discarded/downgraded.
reviews.correction: Added profile card type and explicit public-safe field projection.

reviews.finding: Staging plan did not test current File 20, admin nesting or executable Component API behavior.
reviews.correction: Added exact File 20, admin-parent and Component API scenarios while retaining pending staging truth.

reviews.finding: Structural verifier still encoded prior File 20 assumptions and did not require the new canonical integration classes.
reviews.correction: Verifier now checks current File 20 contract, admin/component integration and exact staging scenarios.

reviews.finding: Executable Component API existed but was not published through the versioned File 25 contract.
reviews.correction: Component API now registers and exposes its versioned contract.

reviews.finding: New integration called get_id() instead of canonical Timeline_Provider::get_provider_id().
reviews.correction: Corrected to the exact interface method and retained registry duplicate protection.

reviews.finding: Rehoming could leave the top-level page's self-submenu orphaned.
reviews.correction: Removes both old child and self-submenu before removing the standalone parent.

reviews.finding: Admin integration contract was not exposed in the main visual contract.
reviews.correction: Main File 25 contract now carries admin_integration evidence.

reviews.finding: CI exposed a stale File 20 1.2.0 assertion in master-plan reconciliation.
reviews.correction: Regression now requires File 20 1.4.12, exact head, contract 1.0.0 and current integration scenarios.

reviews.finding: Artifact verifier independently retained the stale File 20 1.2.0 assertion.
reviews.correction: Verifier rebuilt around current File 20 contract while retaining checksum, manifest, traversal, symlink and expansion defenses.

reviews.finding: Design_System::contract fatally referenced File_20_Integration when isolated tests loaded the design system without that class.
reviews.correction: File 20 detection and contract exposure now degrade safely when the integration class is not loaded.

reviews.lens: PHP/WordPress floor and bootstrap fail-closed behavior
Canonical Sabri Green and visual-token ownership
Same-site media and destination URL enforcement
Founder canonical spelling and identity immutability
Public action destinations hide when native route is absent

reviews.external_blocker: Canonical alias/redirect/SEO parity still requires Hostinger multi-plugin staging.

reviews.lens: Provider transactionality and malformed-provider fail-closed behavior
Deterministic package/checksum/manifest/archive defenses and truthful external status

reviews.evidence: This ledger plus executable gate must pass on the final exact HEAD before the cycle may be reported closed.
